messages.name: MD. Robiul Hasan Monir
messages.text:
Managing Director
MD. Robiul Hasan Monir

Assalamu Alaikum. As the Managing Director of Monir Group, I would like to express my sincere greetings to you all. Corporate governance is a top priority for us as a responsible economic entity. We are committed to not only satisfying our investors but also contributing to the benefit and development of society, while ensuring environmental sustainability.

The saying “No money, no business; No proper education, no success” is often used by those who have yet to achieve success in their lives. However, I firmly believe that every individual possesses the hidden potential to shine. It is those who differentiate themselves from others through their merit, hard work, and perseverance that become exceptional.

At MonirEnterprise, we are dedicated to providing quality poultry products to our customers. We take our commitment seriously and have achieved tremendous success and acceptance from our stakeholders within a short period of time. Our current annual growth rate is 40%, and we attribute this to our focus on quality, commitment, and ethics.

We aspire to contribute to the socio-economic development of Bangladesh and look forward to making significant contributions in the future.

messages.name: Md Monsur Ahmed
messages.text:
Chairman
Md Monsur Ahmed

Bismillahir Rahmanir Rahim. As the Chairman of Monir Group, I would like to express my gratitude for your continued trust and support. Since our inception, we have been striving to achieve excellence in everything we do, and we have come a long way in realizing our vision of becoming a leading importer and exporter of poultry products in Bangladesh.

At MonirEnterprise, we believe that success is not just about financial gain, but also about making a positive impact on society and the environment. Therefore, we are committed to upholding the highest standards of corporate social responsibility, ethics, and sustainability in all our operations. We firmly believe that by doing so, we can contribute to the greater good of the communities we serve and create long-term value for our stakeholders.

As we look to the future, we remain focused on our core values of quality, reliability, and innovation. We are constantly exploring new opportunities to expand our business, improve our products and services, and leverage the latest technologies and industry best practices. With the support of our dedicated team of professionals, we are confident that we can achieve our goals and continue to grow and prosper.

Thank you for your trust and confidence in MonirEnterprise. We look forward to serving you with excellence and integrity for many years to come.
